prompt: Review whether Labcorp has a material causal relationship to precision biology and healthcare automation using current primary evidence; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Labcorp's diagnostics, specialty testing, Central Laboratories and advanced-technology investment can transmit validated precision-testing and laboratory-workflow adoption into volume, mix, recurring testing revenue and margins.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if precision and automation offerings remain immaterial to organic growth and margins, reimbursement blocks adoption, or implementation costs absorb the customer and shareholder benefit.
